title: RAGE Path (optional)
description: A precomputed multi-hop attack path: an ordered chain of edges from a source node to a target. Optional extension kind — consumers that don't understand it skip it.

edge_ids.description: ordered edge_ids forming the path; each MUST reference an edge in the graph

score.description: aggregate path score (e.g. sum of edge weights); see spec/format.md for weight semantics
